title: Italy photo source verification — batch 03
scope: The remaining 19 unchecked Italy image records, plus replacement of two previously flagged source exceptions (Cinque Terre and Tropea). These decisions cover only existing image slots and preserve all current routes.
method: Opened each exact Wikimedia Commons file page and compared its depicted subject, page author/uploader, stated license version and any separate notices with the source manifest. The project fetcher then rechecked Commons metadata and local image integrity for all 21 current records. Four newly selected derivatives were visually inspected after conversion. A Commons page statement is not an independent audit of the underlying rights chain.
findings: Of the remaining 19 source pages, 17 matched their recorded creator, place and license and were retained. The Cannaregio and San Marco source pages carried separate no-social-media restrictions; since the site publishes og:image previews, those two images were replaced with place-matched alternatives.

The earlier Tropea source used the name Luigino in the uploader field and Luigino C. in the description; the identity could not be resolved. The earlier Cinque Terre page had a separate author request for contact before commercial use alongside the CC BY-SA 4.0 section. Both images were replaced conservatively. No photographer was contacted and no email, sample image or link was sent.

Four new source pages were checked for the replacement selections. Norbert Nagel’s Tropea page explicitly describes its specimen-copy/link request as optional rather than a license condition. The new Cinque Terre page has no pre-contact request. These observations do not invalidate or revoke the old source pages’ stated licenses.

The Positano, Sacra di San Michele, Perugia and Vicenza pages contain generic Wiki Loves Monuments authorisation boilerplate; the inspected pages did not show a separate explicit commercial-reproduction restriction.
The Padua source description names Piero tasso while the uploader account is P tasso; the visible creator attribution retains both names.

The inventory leaves 713 of 779 sitewide image license claims unverified at source-page level. Complete source, creator and license metadata is not equivalent to independently confirmed rights ownership.
